evals.name: structure-components-into-tiers
evals.prompt: our components folder is a flat pile of 60 files — organise it by atomic design, and tell me where the page templates belong
evals.expected_output: Loads devbot:atomic-design and places each component at the lowest tier that describes it, records the compose-downward rule, colocated test/story/barrel per folder, and maps templates/pages onto the framework's routing directory. It does not touch the token layer.

assertions.text: The atomic-design skill is loaded, not the design-system one
assertions.description: Tier structure is the boundary this eval pins

assertions.text: Each component is assigned a tier with a reason, and the import direction stays downward
assertions.description: The rule that makes the tiers mean something

assertions.text: Token or theme changes are explicitly out of scope for this task

evals.name: shadcn-primitive-wrapping
evals.prompt: where do the shadcn components go in this structure — do they sit in atoms or outside the tiers?
evals.expected_output: Loads devbot:atomic-design and keeps generated primitives outside the tiers (lib/shadcn), with an atom wrapping each primitive so there is one place to restyle or swap it.

assertions.description: Primitive placement is a tier question

assertions.text: Primitives stay outside the tiers and are wrapped by the lowest tier
